title: 完整人工智能培训课程仓库
summary: 该仓库为Prof. Fernando Amaral的完整AI培训课程，涵盖机器学习、深度学习、LLM、生成式AI、NLP、智能体、计算机视觉、异常检测、遗传算法、模糊逻辑等，包含Python实践、项目和笔记本。
summary_en: Repository for a comprehensive AI training course covering ML, DL, LLMs, Generative AI, NLP, Agents, Computer Vision, Anomaly Detection, Genetic Algorithms, Fuzzy Logic, with hands-on Python practice and notebooks.
